title: Quản trị kinh doanh bảo hiểm 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental knowledge of insurance business administration, market, and enterprise management.
Analyze and evaluate business activities, organizational structure, and strategic planning in insurance business.
Conduct market analysis and assess policies in insurance business.
Manage insurance products, pricing, and quality control.
Manage distribution channels and intermediaries in insurance business.
Develop and implement business strategies in insurance enterprises.
Work effectively in teams and present findings.
Apply logical and critical thinking to analyze and solve problems in insurance business.
Demonstrate leadership skills in managing resources and improving business efficiency.
Plan, coordinate, and manage resources to evaluate and improve business activities.
